title: the quarry Rising
author: Yara Iversen
blurb: August Crane, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must save the tradition that made the town before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
